CM_ANTIOXIDANT_06.instructions: Consume 1500 mL electrolyte hydration solution with antioxidant-fortified spaceflight ration pack.
CM_ANTIOXIDANT_06.title: Antioxidant-Rich Hydration & Carotenoid Ration

CM_CARDIO_PACED_BREATH_07.instructions: Suspend high-load resistive exercise for 4 hours, perform 10 minutes of 6-breaths/min vagal paced breathing, and consume 500 mL oral electrolyte solution.
CM_CARDIO_PACED_BREATH_07.title: Autonomic Paced-Breathing & Restorative Hydration Protocol

CM_LBNP_01.instructions: Perform LBNP session at -20 to -25 mmHg to sequester lower-extremity fluid and attenuate cephalad venous congestion per NASA HRP SANS protocol.
CM_LBNP_01.title: Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) Countermeasure Session

CM_LOW_SODIUM_02.instructions: Select low-sodium ration pack (<2000 mg/day target) and log standard crew B-complex nutritional supplement.
CM_LOW_SODIUM_02.title: Low-Sodium Ration & One-Carbon Folate/B-Vitamin Support

CM_MELATONIN_04.instructions: Follow Flight Surgeon pre-approved circadian sleep hygiene protocol 30 minutes prior to scheduled sleep window; eliminate caffeine 8 hours before sleep.
CM_MELATONIN_04.title: Pre-Sleep Circadian Phase Alignment Protocol

CM_SHIELD_SHELTER_05.instructions: Remain inside shielded storm shelter station until personal dosimeter readings return below 0.5 mSv/day.
CM_SHIELD_SHELTER_05.title: Relocate to High-Mass Polyethylene Storm Shelter Zone

CM_SSLA_BLUE_03.instructions: Set habitat Solid-State Lighting Assembly (SSLA) to high-melanopic 460nm spectrum for 30 minutes during wake phase; switch to warm red-depleted mode 90 minutes pre-sleep.
CM_SSLA_BLUE_03.title: SSLA 460nm Blue-Enriched Circadian Light Alignment
